name: Shell
description: Local shell and SSH/SFTP terminals in the DBX workbench: run commands and manage remote files.
releaseNotes: File panel activity log is now collapsible (hidden when empty, auto-expands on upload progress or errors, with unread badge and clear button); drag-and-drop upload accepts drops across the whole workbench when the host allows HTML5 drag & drop; sidecar identity is now kept in sync with the manifest via a regression test.

zh-CN.name: Shell
zh-CN.description: 在 DBX 工作台中打开本地 Shell 与 SSH/SFTP 终端，执行命令并管理远程文件。
